column2: 生き残った時間に30秒ごとに450点（秒数に応じて計算。途中で終わった場合も端数は加算）、有効ダメージ1につき2点、撃破1体につき30点。各得点にイージー×1.0・ノーマル×1.1・ハード×1.2の難易度倍率がかかります。敵との距離や人数、移動・静止に関係なく生存点が加算されます。制限時間は2分。銃を撃たず、1体も倒さずに完走すると「パルクールクリア」として合計が1.3倍になります。同じ難易度で完走した場合は、ダメージ・撃破による得点で差がつきます。全難易度でスコアを競います。
column3: Earn 450 points every 30 seconds survived (prorated by elapsed time; any partial interval is added when the run ends), 2 per unit of effective damage and 30 per kill. Each component receives the difficulty multiplier: Easy ×1.0, Normal ×1.1 or Hard ×1.2. Survival points grow regardless of enemy distance, count or whether you move. Rounds last two minutes. Finishing without firing the gun and without a single kill is a "Parkour clear" and multiplies the total by 1.3. Finishers on the same difficulty are separated by damage and kill points. All difficulties compete on score.

column3: Score is calculated from survival time and kills. Time multiplier = (1 + difficulty × 0.1) × (1 + seconds survived ÷ 60); the kill multiplier is double that. Survival and kills are rounded down separately, then added. Knocking a zombie off counts as one kill, and moves themselves give no points. The score includes the difficulty bonus (Easy ×1.0, Normal ×1.1, Hard ×1.2) and competes with all difficulties. Your score at the moment you're caught also counts for the ranking.
